pages.title: The Sin Lords
pages.text: Deep in the Spirit Realm sleep seven Sin Lords, each in a floating sanctum whose seven pillars cast beams of its colour into the sky.$(br2)Come within 20 blocks of the seat (or strike it) to wake it; stray too far, or leave it alone for half a minute, and it returns, heals and sleeps. At half health it is $(l)enraged$().$(br2)One of each per world; each drops its sin's boss material and alchemy recipes.

pages.title: Sigils and Statues
pages.text: A vanquished Sin Lord leaves an unbreakable $(l)statue$() where it fell.$(br2)Right-click it with that sin's $(l)sigil$(): the sigil is spent and the lord rises again and returns to its sanctum.$(br2)$(l)Sigils$(): dropped by a boss of that sin bearing $(l)7 affixes$() (its sin's among them), to a killer of $(l)level 50$() or more.

pages.title: Pride, the Archer
pages.text: The strongest, 600 health, hovering out of reach.$(li)$(l)Gate of the Treasury$(): golden portals hurl any weapon in the game, other mods' too, hitting as hard as the weapon$(li)$(l)Chains of Heaven$(): binds you for 2.5 s$(li)$(l)Sky Volley$() (enraged): two dozen weapons rain down$(li)Comes within 4 blocks of you and he blinks away

pages.title: Wrath, the Berserker
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Rage$(): faster and harder with every wound$(li)$(l)Mad Charge$(): embers mark its path, then it charges; run it into a wall and it staggers$(li)$(l)Shatter$(): leaping slam, 6 blocks$(li)$(l)Roar$() (enraged): weakness, slowness, knockback$(li)$(l)Twelve Labours$(): rises once from death

pages.title: Envy, the Assassin
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Shadow Step$(): unseen for 2.5 s, then a blinding backstab$(li)$(l)Envious Shades$(): three fragile shadows of itself$(li)$(l)Usurp$(): copies the weapon in your hand and seals yours for 5 s

pages.title: Greed, the Rider
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Plunder$(): every hit takes up to 3 of your levels (5 enraged) and heals it; all returned when it falls$(li)$(l)Golden Charge$(): three charges in a row$(li)$(l)Gold Rain$(): five circles of coins, then the gold falls

pages.title: Lust, the Caster
pages.text: Floats, keeping her distance.$(li)$(l)Charm$(): for 3 s you are drawn to her, dizzy and weak, while she heals$(li)$(l)Butterflies$(): five (eight enraged) seeking butterflies$(li)$(l)Mirage$(): she vanishes elsewhere, leaving a bloom that bursts

pages.title: Gluttony, the Lancer
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Devoured$(): its lance's wounds stop all healing for a while; every blow feeds it$(li)$(l)Soul Lunge$(): drives forward nine blocks$(li)$(l)Gorge$(): draws in everything within 14 blocks, then bites, healing twice the damage$(li)$(l)Hurled Lance$()

pages.title: Sloth, the Saber
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Field of Sloth$(): slowness and mining fatigue within 14 blocks$(li)$(l)Doze$(): naps 3 s, taking 60% less harm and mending$(li)$(l)Oath Blade$(): a line of light runs out toward you for 2.5 s, then becomes a 30-block blade: step off the line!$(li)$(l)Sword Pressure$(): a half-circle sweep
